The sgRNA of the corn ZmCENH3 gene is designed, and the nucleotide sequence of the sgRNA is shown as SEQ ID NO.1-SEQ ID NO.2; the method comprises the following steps of: respectively connecting a DNA (Deoxyribonucleic Acid) fragment for coding the sgRNA sequence and Cas9 coding protein into a basic vector, transforming the constructed vector into agrobacterium to obtain recombinant agrobacterium, mediating and infecting corn by the recombinant agrobacterium to obtain positive plants, respectively screening the positive plants containing gene fragments of Cas9 and sgRNA, and hybridizing the positive plants to obtain the Cas9 and sgRNA hybrid gene. And carrying out PCR amplification sequencing on the filial generation, analyzing the mutation type of the corn plant, and screening to obtain a mutant plant of the corn ZmCENH3 gene.(ZH) 本发明公开了利用CRISPR/Cas9系统编辑玉米ZmCENH3基因的sgRNA及其应用，本发明设计了玉米ZmCENH3基因的sgRNA，其核苷酸序列如SEQ ID NO.1～SEQ ID NO.2所示；并通过将含有编码所述sgRNA序列的DNA片段和Cas9编码蛋白分别连接到基础载体中，将构建好的载体转化至农杆菌中获得重组农杆菌，并以重组农杆菌介导侵染玉米，获得阳性植株，分别筛选含Cas9和sgRNA的基因片段的阳性植株，并将两者进行杂交，对其杂交后代进行PCR扩增测序，分析玉米植株突变类型，同时筛选得到玉米ZmCENH3基因的突变体植株。",,China,26.05.2023,B,北京慕达星云知识产权代理事务所(特殊普通合伙) 11465,116463348,14.05.2024

View less classifications","INSTITUTE OF CROP SCIENCE, CHINESE ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES中国农业科学院作物科学研究所",FU BINYING傅彬英DU FENGPING杜丰平WANG WENSHENG王文生ZHAO XIUQIN赵秀琴WANG JUAN汪娟LI YINGBO李英博ZHANG YUE张岳,,,(EN) Application of rice OsbHLH38 protein and coding gene thereof in improving abiotic stress resistance of plants(ZH) 水稻OsbHLH38蛋白及其编码基因在提高植物抗非生物胁迫中的用途,"(EN) The invention discloses a rice OsbHLH38 protein and application of a coding gene of the rice OsbHLH38 protein to improvement of abiotic stress resistance of plants. According to the invention, overexpression and CRISPR (clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats) knockout technologies are respectively adopted to carry out overexpression or knockout mutation on the rice OsbHLH38 gene in rice, and according to phenotypic changes of transgenic rice plants, it is found that overexpression of the OsbHLH38 gene in rice can significantly improve the ability of rice to resist salt stress; therefore, the invention provides the application of the rice OsbHLH38 protein and the coding gene thereof in improving the abiotic stress resistance of the plant, and the application comprises the following steps: overexpressing the rice OsbHLH38 gene in the plant to obtain a transgenic plant, and the abiotic stress resistance of the obtained transgenic plant is obviously enhanced. The method has application prospects in the aspects of improving and enhancing rice stress resistance, accelerating the stress-resistant molecular breeding process and the like.(ZH) 本发明公开了水稻OsbHLH38蛋白及其编码基因在提高植物抗非生物胁迫中的用途。本发明分别采用超表达和CRISPR敲除技术将水稻OsbHLH38基因在水稻中进行超表达或进行敲除突变，根据转基因水稻植株的表型变化发现，在水稻中超表达OsbHLH38基因能够显著改善水稻抵御盐胁迫的能力；因此，本发明提供了水稻OsbHLH38蛋白及其编码基因能够在提高植物对于非生物胁迫抗性中的应用，包括：将水稻OsbHLH38基因在植物中进行过表达得到转基因植物，所得到的转基因植物对于非生物胁迫的抗性明显增强。本发明在改良、增强水稻抗逆性以及加速抗逆分子育种进程等方面具有应用前景。",,China,28.06.2022,B,北京思元知识产权代理事务所(普通合伙) 11598北京思元知识产权代理事务所(普通合伙) 11598,114805522,20.09.2022

View less classifications",FUJIAN AGRICULTURE AND FORESTRY UNIVERSITY福建农林大学,CHEN XIAOMIN陈小敏FAN JIAXIN樊嘉鑫HUANG LINWAN黄琳婉ZHANG JUN张君TANG WEI汤蔚WANG ZONGHUA王宗华,,,(EN) Rice gene OsCAD8B and application thereof(ZH) 一种水稻基因OsCAD8B及其应用,"(EN) The invention discloses a rice gene OsCAD8B, the nucleotide sequence of the rice gene OsCAD8B is as shown in SEQ ID NO.1, and the amino acid sequence of a protein coded by the rice gene OsCAD8B is as shown in SEQ ID NO.2. On the basis of an open reading frame and the amino acid sequence of the rice gene OsCAD8B, a rice gene editing carrier OsCAD8B-pYLCRISPR/Cas9Pubi-H is constructed by utilizing a CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing technology, and the rice gene is transformed into pYLCRISPR/Cas9Pubi-H by an agrobacterium-mediated transformation method. An OsCAD8B-pYLCRISPR/Cas9Pubi-H gene editing carrier is introduced into a rice callus tissue, and a corresponding transgenic line is obtained. The application has the advantages that crop genetic improvement is carried out through OSCAD8B gene editing, and the rice blast resistance is remarkably improved; the wild type and the OscAD8B-ko rice plants are further subjected to a magnaporthe oryzae inoculation experiment, and the result shows that the resistance of the rice plants to the magnaporthe oryzae is improved by knocking out the OscAD8B, the rice form is not influenced, and the influence on the thousand seed weight of the seeds is small.(ZH) 本发明公开了一种水稻基因OsCAD8B，其核苷酸序列如SEQ ID NO.1所示，其编码的蛋白的氨基酸序列如SEQ ID NO.2所示，以水稻基因OsCAD8B开放阅读框和氨基酸序列为基础，利用CRISPR/Cas9基因编辑技术，构建水稻基因编辑载体OsCAD8B‑pYLCRISPR/Cas9Pubi‑H，通过农杆菌介导的转化方法，将OsCAD8B‑pYLCRISPR/Cas9Pubi‑H基因编辑载体导入水稻愈伤组织中，获得相对应的转基因株系。本发明的优点：通过OsCAD8B基因编辑进行作物遗传改良，显著提高了抗稻瘟的能力；进一步对野生型和Oscad8B‑ko水稻植株进行稻瘟病菌接种实验，结果显示敲除OsCAD8B提高了水稻植株对稻瘟病菌的抗性，且不影响水稻形态，对种子的千粒重影响较小。",,China,12.03.2024,A,福州市鼓楼区年盛知识产权代理事务所(普通合伙) 35254,,

View less classifications","INSTITUTE OF CROP SCIENCE, CHINESE ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES中国农业科学院作物科学研究所",XIA LANQIN夏兰琴LI SHAOYA李少雅ZHAO YUNDE赵云德ZHANG XIN张欣WANG WENSHENG王文生DU WENMING杜文明,,,(EN) Application for using LbCpf1-RR mutant in CRISPR/Cpf1 system in plant gene editing(ZH) LbCpf1-RR突变体用于CRISPR/Cpf1系统在植物基因编辑中的应用,"(EN) The invention discloses application for using an LbCpf1 - RR mutant in a CRISPR/Cpf1 system in plant gene editing. The application for using the LbCpf1 - RR mutant in the CRISPR/Cpf1 system in plant gene editing uses an OsPDS gene and an OsSBEIIb gene as target genes, constructs a target double loci of one gene and a series of vectors of two genes, and utilizes an agrobacterium-mediated transformation method to import the vectors into rice callus, and rice plants with the target gene knockout are successfully obtained by using the LbCpf1-RR mutant. The only difference between the LbCpf1-RR mutant and the protein LbCpf1 is that the 532nd amino acid changes from G to R, and the 595th amino acid changes from K to R. The LbCpf1-RR mutant provided by the application for using the LbCpf1 - RR mutant in the CRISPR/Cpf1 system in plant gene editing expands the PAM site sequence identified by the LbCpf1-RR mutant, so that the editing range of the CRISPR/Cpf1 system in rice genome is expanded, great significance for promoting the application of the system in the field of plant genome editing is achieved. The application for using the LbCpf1 - RR mutant in the CRISPR/Cpf1 system in plant geneediting has great application value.(ZH) 本发明公开了LbCpf1‑RR突变体用于CRISPR/Cpf1系统在植物基因编辑中的应用。本发明以OsPDS基因和OsSBEIIb基因为靶基因，构建了靶向一个基因的双位点和两个基因的系列载体，并利用农杆菌转化方法将载体导入水稻愈伤中，利用LbCpf1‑RR突变体成功获得了目的基因敲除的水稻植株。LbCpf1‑RR突变体与蛋白质LbCpf1的唯一不同在于：第532位的氨基酸由G变为R，第595位的氨基酸由K变为R。本发明提供的LbCpf1‑RR突变体由于扩充了其识别的PAM位点序列，所以扩大了CRISPR/Cpf1系统在水稻基因组中的编辑范围，对于推进此系统在植物基因组编辑领域中的应用有重要意义。本发明具有重大的应用价值。",,China,16.03.2018,B,北京纪凯知识产权代理有限公司 11245,108486146,19.02.2021
